subject.title: feat(mobile): default pairing to full node access

question: Should official mobile setup codes grant `operator.admin` by default, and if so must that privilege be constructible only by the exact server-owned mobile profile with matching native client metadata?
rationale: This changes the default least-privilege boundary for a credential that controls Gateway settings and upgrades; code review can identify the unsafe generic-purpose implementation but cannot choose the permanent product and trust policy.

options.title: Canonical full-mobile profile
options.body: Keep full access as the default, but make the Gateway construct and recognize one exact closed profile and strip or reject `mobile-full` everywhere else.

options.title: Bounded default
options.body: Retain the existing bounded default and expose full administrative access only as an explicit operator-selected setup mode.

options.title: Pause the default change
options.body: Keep the feature open until native-client identity and bootstrap attestation provide a stronger boundary for automatic admin grants.

recommendation.title: Canonical full-mobile profile
recommendation.body: Keep full access as the default, but make the Gateway construct and recognize one exact closed profile and strip or reject `mobile-full` everywhere else.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked issue and PR establish this as a product-level mobile default decision, and their merged gateway history makes them the best available decision owner.
